experiment_cards.interpretation_limit: This is a patent-reported, early-phase, nonrandomized, unconfirmed response outcome. It is not a phase 3 treatment effect or a validated forecast.
experiment_cards.response_evaluable_definition: Baseline and post-baseline tumor assessment, or discontinuation of study treatment (PDF p94, paragraph [0459]).

experiment_cards.title: DS-1062a phase 1 observed human pharmacokinetics under repeated 8 mg/kg dosing
experiment_cards.experiment_system: Preliminary single- and multiple-dose human pharmacokinetics evaluated using noncompartmental analysis in the phase 1 DS-1062a program. The quantitative passage describes repeated 8 mg/kg dosing; it does not specify the cycle used for the reported summaries.
experiment_cards.species_or_cell: Human subjects in the referenced phase 1 NSCLC clinical program; no animal data are included in this card.

sample_size.denominator_limit: 61 refers to the overall PK analysis across doses, not the number contributing to each repeated 8 mg/kg parameter. ORR n=34, response-evaluable n=88 and treated n=95 are separate efficacy denominators and are not assigned to PK.

dose.route_basis: Phase 1 intravenous infusion described on PDF88 [0427].
dose.schedule_limit: The observed PK passage does not state the parameter cycle or exact dosing schedule. Figure23 shows a repeated profile on a 0/21/42/63-day axis; this card does not infer individual dosing times or use Example4 simulated q3w x3 as an observed regimen.

experiment_cards.endpoint: Mean AUClast, Cmax and mean terminal half-life reported in the repeated DS-1062a 8 mg/kg PK passage; these are exposure parameters, not efficacy endpoints.

result.reported_context: Repeated DS-1062a 8 mg/kg; values are transcribed from [0462], not digitized from Figure23.
result.analyte_assignment_limit: The passage names DS-1062a together with total antibody and payload profiles, but does not separately label the numerical parameter triple per analyte. No total-antibody or payload numeric parameters are generated.
result.reported_qualitative_observation: DS-1062a and total anti-TROP2 antibody plasma levels were described as similar; free-drug exposure was described as lower. The patent interprets this as circulation stability; the card does not quantify a release fraction.

experiment_cards.unit: AUClast: ug*day/mL; Cmax: ug/mL; terminal half-life: day. Original printed microgram units were visually checked.
experiment_cards.data_cutoff_limit: The preceding Example7 efficacy paragraph dates its response data to 2019-11-16. The PK subsection does not explicitly date the PK population or parameters; that efficacy cutoff is not silently assigned to PK.

source_discrepancies.action: Use original-page microgram unit in this new candidate card; preserve archived OCR unchanged.

excluded_materials.reason: Cynomolgus-monkey measurements feed target-mediated drug-disposition modeling and predicted human concentration profiles; not the observed human PK parameters in this card.
ORR and its dose-specific efficacy denominators remain in the existing ORR card; they are not reclassified as PK denominators.
Only labels and context checked; no concentration values or error-bar type were digitized or inferred.

experiment_cards.interpretation_limit: Patent-reported preliminary human PK may inform an exposure hypothesis. It does not establish exposure-response, comparative efficacy, current phase3 dosing, a safety margin, primary PFS benefit, a clinical success probability or incremental forecasting accuracy. No extrapolation from 8 mg/kg single-agent early-phase PK to the AVANZAR combination target is performed.
experiment_cards.extraction_method: Unchanged archived OCR used for location; original PDF87/88/93/94/129 visually checked in two same-base AI role contexts. Numeric units come from PDF94, not OCR or Figure23 digitization.

document_observations.observation: Example 4 calls antibody-drug conjugate (1) DS-1062a. Example 7 reports a phase 1 response dataset, not a randomized phase 3 effect.
